==Usage==
This template is used to cite the [[Bantha Tracks (newsletter)|''Bantha Tracks'']] newsletter and its articles. It should not be used to cite the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' section of the same name, as this falls under the umbrella of another citation template: {{Tl|InsiderCite}}. 

Use the following code:
<code><nowiki>{{BanthaCite|issue=|article=}}</nowiki></code>

==Example(s)==
For articles in the newsletter that do not have/need articles on the site:

<code><nowiki>{{BanthaCite|16|The Empire Strikes Back in New NPR Drama Series}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{BanthaCite|16|The Empire Strikes Back in New NPR Drama Series}}

<hr />
For articles that do have internal articles:

<code><nowiki>{{BanthaCite|16|article=In Conversation with Carrie Fisher, 1982|Interview: Carrie Fisher}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{BanthaCite|16|article=In Conversation with Carrie Fisher, 1982|Interview: Carrie Fisher}}
